environment_dependent_files.reason: Parametrized over the PowerShell hosts actually installed (HOSTS = [n for n in ('powershell', 'pwsh') if shutil.which(n)], line 58). A Windows box has both and collects 322; the ubuntu runner has pwsh only and collects 163. That is the point of the file -- the guard once passed under pwsh 7 and was a parser error under Windows PowerShell 5.1 -- so the variance is the design, not drift.
